items.t: COP31 climate summit ends with no deal
items.d: The longest UN climate summit on record closed in Antalya without agreement after the EU, UK and Tuvalu rejected a text that dropped any mention of fossil fuels.

items.t: AI sell-off spreads to Asian markets
items.d: South Korea's Kospi fell as much as 5.8% on Monday, with Hong Kong and China also lower, after Friday's slump pushed the S&P 500 into a correction and wiped out the Nasdaq's 2026 gains.

items.t: Burnham to sell 'landmark' EU deal to MPs
items.d: The prime minister will tell MPs Friday's agreement with the EU is a choice between a broken status quo and change, as Tories vow to scrap it.

items.t: Russian ship hit by suspected drone at Libyan port
items.d: An explosion struck a Russia-bound vessel refuelling in eastern Libya, officials said, a day after another Russia-bound ship was attacked in the Gulf of Finland.

items.t: Drone strikes hit Khartoum, UN site damaged
items.d: At least four people were killed in drone attacks on Sudan's capital and Omdurman on Sunday, with a UN facility among the sites hit.

items.t: Indonesia sweet factory fire leaves dozens missing
items.d: Rescuers have recovered 24 body bags from a confectionery factory fire in Banten province, with about 30 people still unaccounted for.

items.t: Hong Kong hosts Interpol general assembly
items.d: Police chiefs from 196 countries meet in Hong Kong from Monday for four days, with temporary no-fly zones for drones across the city.

items.t: Wall Street enters correction as AI trade unravels
items.d: The S&P 500 fell 3.7% and the Nasdaq 5.3% on Friday as investors dumped Nvidia, Anthropic and other AI names over doubts about huge spending plans.

items.t: British Gas owner warns over soaring bills
items.d: Centrica boss Chris O'Shea says more households will be unable or unwilling to pay as energy prices climb this winter.

items.t: Delta system fault delays hundreds of flights
items.d: A failure in Delta's weight-and-balance automation caused widespread delays at Atlanta airport on Sunday, averaging close to an hour.

items.t: Anthropic researcher claims Riemann hypothesis proof
items.d: Mathematician Levent Alpöge says he proved maths' most famous open problem with help from Claude; rival claims have emerged and experts urge caution until it is checked.

items.t: FBI probes apparent hack of crime database
items.d: The National Crime Information Center, shared by US federal and local police, appears to have been breached, according to reports.

items.t: Trump threatens ban on overseas AI data centres
items.d: The US president floated barring American firms from building AI data centres abroad, giving few details on how it would work.

items.t: Korean minister quits over AI exam cheating
items.d: Choi Kyo-jin resigned after admitting last-minute steps to stop AI-assisted cheating in the college entrance exam caused chaos.

items.t: RAF says next fighter may be last with a pilot
items.d: The RAF chief said AI-enabled uncrewed aircraft should begin flying in UK airspace next year.

items.t: NHS launches world's biggest AI breast screening trial
items.d: Researchers will test whether AI can spot breast cancer earlier in routine screening, which could ease pressure on radiologists.

items.t: Judge approves $7.25bn Roundup cancer settlement
items.d: Bayer will pay users of Roundup weedkiller who have non-Hodgkin lymphoma, and those diagnosed in future.

items.t: Theresa May tells Burnham to accept Brexit
items.d: The former PM said she was aghast at the government's EU plans, while the Tories pledged to scrap the deal.

items.t: PIP assessments need overhaul, report to say
items.d: Disability minister Sir Stephen Timms will recommend major changes to how personal independence payment claims are assessed.

items.t: Manchester's Co-op Live evacuated during concert
items.d: A major incident was declared after an unknown substance was released in the crowd; one person went to hospital.

items.t: COP31氣候峰會無協議告終
items.d: 史上最長的聯合國氣候峰會在安塔利亞閉幕，未能達成協議。歐盟、英國及圖瓦盧拒絕接受刪去化石燃料字眼的文本。

items.t: AI股拋售潮蔓延亞洲股市
items.d: 南韓綜合指數周一一度急跌5.8%，港股及內地股市亦下跌。上周五美股重挫，標普500指數陷入調整，納斯達克今年升幅盡失。

items.t: 賓咸向國會推銷「里程碑」英歐協議
items.d: 首相賓咸將向議員表示，上周五與歐盟達成的協議是在「破碎的現狀」與改變之間作出選擇；保守黨揚言上台後會撤銷協議。

items.t: 俄船在利比亞港口疑遭無人機襲擊
items.d: 利比亞東部官員稱，一艘駛返俄羅斯的船隻在港口補給時發生爆炸；此前一日，另一艘前往俄羅斯的船在芬蘭灣遇襲。

items.t: 喀土穆遭無人機襲擊 聯合國設施受損
items.d: 蘇丹首都喀土穆及恩圖曼周日多處遭無人機襲擊，最少4人死亡，一處聯合國設施受損。

items.t: 印尼糖果廠大火 數十人失蹤
items.d: 印尼萬丹省糖果廠火災，救援人員已整理出24個屍袋，另有約30人下落不明。

items.t: 香港主辦國際刑警大會
items.d: 國際刑警組織第94屆全體大會周一起一連四日在香港舉行，196個成員國警隊首長出席，全港設臨時無人機禁飛區。

items.t: 美股陷入調整 AI交易崩潰
items.d: 上周五標普500指數跌3.7%，納指跌5.3%。投資者憂慮巨額AI開支，大舉拋售Nvidia、Anthropic等AI股。

items.t: British Gas母公司憂能源費飆升
items.d: Centrica行政總裁奧謝表示，今冬能源價格上升，無力或不願繳費的家庭將會增加。

items.t: 達美航空系統故障 數百航班延誤
items.d: 達美航空重量與平衡自動化系統故障，周日亞特蘭大機場數以百計航班延誤，平均近一小時。

items.t: Anthropic研究員稱證明黎曼猜想
items.d: 數學家Alpöge稱借助Claude證明了數學界最著名的未解難題，但亦有對立說法出現，專家提醒須待驗證。

items.t: FBI調查犯罪資料庫疑遭入侵
items.d: 據報美國聯邦及地方警察共用的國家犯罪資訊中心資料庫疑遭黑客入侵，FBI正調查。

items.t: 特朗普揚言禁美企海外建AI數據中心
items.d: 美國總統特朗普提出可能禁止美國企業在海外興建AI數據中心，但未有交代細節。

items.t: 南韓教育部長因AI考試作弊辭職
items.d: 南韓教育部長崔教振承認為防範高考AI作弊而臨時推出的措施引起混亂，宣布辭職。

items.t: 英空軍：下一代戰機或是最後有人駕駛
items.d: 英國皇家空軍司令表示，具備AI的無人駕駛戰機預計明年開始在英國領空飛行。

items.t: NHS展開全球最大AI乳癌篩查試驗
items.d: 研究人員將測試AI能否在常規篩查中更早發現乳癌，有望減輕放射科人手壓力。

items.t: 法官批准72.5億美元除草劑致癌和解
items.d: 拜耳將向患非霍奇金淋巴瘤的Roundup除草劑用家，以及日後確診者作出賠償。

items.t: 文翠珊促賓咸接受脫歐
items.d: 前首相文翠珊對政府的歐盟計劃表示震驚，保守黨亦承諾會撤銷協議。

items.t: 報告將指PIP評估需徹底改革
items.d: 殘疾事務大臣蒂姆斯將建議大幅改革個人獨立津貼的評估方式。

items.t: 曼徹斯特Co-op Live音樂會疏散
items.d: 有人在觀眾群中釋放不明物質，當局宣布發生重大事故，一人送院。
